Maya (People Ops): Nora Kim handed in resignation today, last day 2026-07-09. Need COBRA timing, equity exercise note, and a staggered offboard because she holds infra SA keys.
Nora (leaving): Will prepare handoff doc for feature-auth. I have two GCP SA keys and SSH deploy keys active.
Jules-IT: Laptop return? remote wipe OK or physical pickup required? Also flag any client data on device.
Priya (Manager): I'll run KT sessions and transfer runbook ownership by 2026-07-07. Please delay SSO disable until 2026-07-10 08:00 PT so Nora can finish the post-release checks.
Maya (People Ops): COBRA packet will be emailed within 2 business days after termination processing. PayrollBot will post final-pay timing.
PayrollBot: Automated: final payroll run 2026-07-12. Prorated salary + accrued PTO payout processed. COBRA packet ETA: 2 business days post-termination. Ticket: #OPS-7901.
Nora (leaving): Question on RSU exercise window for voluntary departures  is it 90 days?
Maya (People Ops): Standard is 90 days for voluntary departures. I'll DM your grant letter to confirm.
Jules-IT: Proposed offboard sequence (runbook v4):
- 2026-07-09 16:30 PT: laptop pickup / asset sign-off
- 2026-07-10 08:00 PT: SSO disable (remove groups)
- 2026-07-10 08:05 PT: revoke GCP service accounts and rotate downstream secrets
- 2026-07-10 08:15 PT: revoke SSH deploy keys and CI tokens
- 2026-07-10 08:30 PT: remove from on-call and PagerDuty
Link: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/offboard-v4
Jules-IT: Will attach access audit to #OPS-7901 when complete.
HiringOps: Priya, please share role brief + must-haves by EOD for a 7/12 posting.
Priya (Manager): Will do. Also requesting 8-week contractor cover starting 7/10 for critical support.
Nora (leaving): One more: shared Drive folder contains client PII. Priya please ensure compliance archiving before my last day.
Priya (Manager): I'll run the data removal checklist and confirm here.
Maya (People Ops): Action list: Maya confirm COBRA wording by 7/01; Jules schedule pickup; HiringOps draft req on brief receipt. Please update this thread as steps close. :white_check_mark:
